title: Sindh Coastal Development Authority Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Coastal Development Authority Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XLVI OF 2018
ACT XLVI OF 2018
SINDH COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Sindh Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 7th June, 2018]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-22/2018, dated 7.6.2018.---The Sindh Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 24th May, 2018 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 05th June, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Act,
2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
